arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Goldenberg argued the Tort Claims Act sets a ceiling based on local law.
Mr. Shah asserted Section 233 precludes civil actions against officers performing medical duties.
Mr. Doyle contended Section 233 does not satisfy the explicit declaration test for abrogation.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: the sides that brought the case want the Court to dismiss the constitutional tort claims against their officers.
